description: Use first to find the key of a macro indicator. Then use get_macro_indicator with that key. Find indicators and their keys. Latest reading, change, next release and source for GDP, CPI and core inflation, unemployment, wages, retail sales, industrial output, NBP rates, FX, consumer sentiment, mortgage market and statutory limits. Filter by group or free text (Polish or English words, e.g. "inflacja", "wages"). Set include_descriptions to learn what each series measures when keys look alike (cpi-rr vs hicp-rr).

include_descriptions.description: Add a one-sentence explanation per indicator. Default false.

query.description: Case-insensitive text matched against key and label.

name: list_macro_indicators
title: List Polish macroeconomic indicators
